claims.claim: Server-side diff ignores destinationServiceAccounts and falls back to the cluster secret credential, forcing operators to maintain unbounded patch RBAC grants or manually disable ServerSideDiff to stop ComparisonError loops that flip app status between Synced and Unknown; detection relies on app status flips or CI failures, with ownership falling to cluster admins who must patch RBAC per new resource kind.

Deprioritizing hydrator rollback alongside the manual-only AllAtOnce deletion mitigation leaves operators with no automated recovery path when progressive sync deletion fails, forcing manual git intervention to prevent auto-sync from applying stale manifests from the stage branch; detection relies on customer impact reports, with ownership falling to night shift operators who lack a runbook to resolve the state inconsistency.

Progressive sync status promotes to Healthy based on the pre-update child application state rather than the newly generated spec, causing the controller to skip sync operations for spec-only changes and leaving child applications silently OutOfSync; detection signal is absent because the ApplicationSet status remains Healthy, leaving ownership with the controller logic that requires manual reconciliation to resolve the drift.
